text: Immersed in this thoughtfully designed environment, I feel as if I am standing at the intersection of curiosity and possibility. The first scene—with its glossy glass walls and quiet, empty meeting room—invites me to pause and reflect on the boundaries between private thought and shared progress. Entering the exhibit in the second image, where the R+D sign gleams, I sense inspiration kindling. This space celebrates human creativity and collaboration, filling me with a hopeful reverence for knowledge and innovation. I am reminded of how environments shape our minds as much as our minds shape them.
